# Gin Web Framework

> Package gin implements a HTTP web framework called gin.

## Go API

- [codec/json](/go-api/pkg-codec-json.html): github.com/gin-gonic/gin/codec/json
- [ginS](/go-api/pkg-ginS.html): github.com/gin-gonic/gin/ginS
- [internal/bytesconv](/go-api/pkg-internal-bytesconv.html): github.com/gin-gonic/gin/internal/bytesconv
- [internal/fs](/go-api/pkg-internal-fs.html): github.com/gin-gonic/gin/internal/fs
- [render](/go-api/pkg-render.html): github.com/gin-gonic/gin/render
